related.name: Audio Dynamic Range & Data Rate Calculator

guidance: Electrical model only: it shows how cable capacitance, winding resistance and load move the resonant peak, not how an instrument sounds. The winding's own self-capacitance and any tone control are not counted, so a real guitar usually peaks somewhat lower and lower in level than shown, and cable capacitance varies with construction, so use the cable's measured or published figure.
method: A passive magnetic pickup is modelled as an ideal voltage source in series with its winding inductance L and winding resistance Rdc, driving the cable capacitance C and the load resistance R in parallel. The divider gives the second-order low-pass H(s) = R / (s^2 L C R + s (L + R C Rdc) + R + Rdc), whose undamped resonance is f0 = sqrt((R + Rdc) / (L C R)) / 2 pi and whose quality factor is Q = sqrt(L C R (R + Rdc)) / (L + R C Rdc). The total capacitance is the cable capacitance per metre times the length. When Q exceeds 1/sqrt(2) the magnitude peaks at f0 sqrt(1 - 1/(2 Q^2)) and the peak stands Q / sqrt(1 - 1/(4 Q^2)) above the flat (DC) level, reported in decibels as 20 log10 of that ratio; at or below that threshold the response falls monotonically and no peak is reported. The -3 dB corner is the frequency where the magnitude is 3 dB below the DC level, and the levels at 2, 5 and 10 kHz are reported against the same DC level, so 0 dB means no change at that frequency. Inputs are accepted from 0.5 to 12 H of pickup inductance, 0.5 to 15 kilo-ohms of winding resistance, 30 to 300 pF/m of cable capacitance, 0.3 to 30 m of cable and a 50 to 2000 kilo-ohm load; decimal commas are accepted. Frequencies are reported to the nearest hertz, Q to two decimals, capacitance to 0.1 pF and levels to 0.1 dB. Warnings fire when Q falls below 0.71 and there is no peak, when the peak sits above 10 kHz or below 2 kHz, and when the peak boost exceeds 6 dB. The model counts only cable capacitance: coil self-capacitance, tone controls, pickup position, string and body resonances and amplifier input non-linearity are outside it.
